summary: Build 8h-a closes the coverage gap to the zero-quadrature mandate via four levers. The final lnlike must never fall back to numerical quadrature: every frequency node of a draw is served by a spline chart, bare ppGO (the existing image-kernel stationary-phase sum), a uniform arm, or exact Schwinger, else it refuses loudly. WP1 builds a NEW hash-pinned data product (the certified-ppGO domain map) that MEASURES, per (parity, gamma-band, caustic-frame annulus), the frequency floor w_cert above which bare ppGO matches exact F to <=1e-4 F-normalized. WP2 makes the likelihood dispatch per-node band-split: chart below w_cert, bare ppGO above, tubes near-caustic, arms at their windows. WP3 adds interior (4-image) far-field tiles and trims mass strata above w_cert. WP4 subdivides the 166 gated v3 edge tiles rather than densifying globally. Producer->consumer ordering: the map (WP1) is produced before the dispatch (WP2) and trainer (WP3/WP4) consume it. Professor authority is baked into every tolerance: w_trust=max(1.5*w_cert, w_cert+2.0); the ppGO error is NON-monotone (image-delay beats can re-cross the bar), so the map stores the sup-over-w floor (last upward re-crossing), never the first crossing; certification bar is 1e-4 F-normalized (1e-3 is probe-only; per-node error accumulates coherently as ~eps*SNR^2); beyond the Schwinger wall the reference does not exist, so those cells are UNKNOWN and dispatch refuses (the measured ~360/1024 m>458 beyond-wall bucket is an invariant pending 8h-b, not a failure). ASSUMPTIONS: (1) the in-build sweep runs at coarse synthetic scale only; the production ppGO map sweep, v4 campaign, and ladder census are POST-BUILD driver steps. (2) surrogate.py serve() stays FROZEN (Simplifier ruling) - band-split lives entirely in likelihood.py dispatch. (3) data_registry.yaml path is resolved via scripts/pipeline_graph.py DEFAULT_REGISTRY. All new tests are authored by the Test Developer from domain_test_descriptions; no Coder authors tests.

work_packages.title: Certified-ppGO domain map (new hash-pinned data product)
work_packages.what: Create a new data product that measures and stores the certified-ppGO frequency floor w_cert per (parity, gamma-band, caustic-frame annulus) cell, following the existing PearceyTable hash-pinned pattern exactly. Two deliverables: (a) a loader module cogwheel/lensing/ppgo_map.py with a CertifiedPpgoMap dataclass (load + SHA1 content-hash verification + a w_cert(parity, gamma, annulus_rho) query returning a certified boundary float or an UNKNOWN sentinel); (b) a producer script scripts/train_ppgo_map.py that runs an offline validation sweep computing per-node |F - ppGO_full|/max|F| against the exact engine on a stratified grid, records the sup-over-w certified floor per cell, and writes an npz with grid axes + w_cert array + JSON provenance (grid bounds, certification bar, safety-margin rule, SHA1 hash). Plus the three mechanical registry edits.
where: NEW cogwheel/lensing/ppgo_map.py; NEW scripts/train_ppgo_map.py; .claude/spec/DATA_CONTRACTS.yaml; data_registry.yaml (path via scripts/pipeline_graph.py DEFAULT_REGISTRY); scripts/regenerate_consumer_graph.py (LOADERS dict). Mirror cogwheel/lensing/chang_refsdal/_pearcey_table.py (PearceyTable.load, _content_hash, evaluate) and scripts/train_pearcey_table.py (main, build/save/held-out-error).
work_packages.how: Mirror the PearceyTable pattern verbatim for load/hash/npz/provenance; do NOT invent a new serialization idiom. The bare ppGO reconstruction is the EXISTING image-kernel sum: geometric_amplification(w, y, gamma, beta, kappa) in cogwheel/lensing/chang_refsdal/operator.py (= sum_a exp(1j*w*tau_a)*geometry.image_kernel(...)); the exact reference F is the engine's exact_total path. Certification currency is F-normalized |F - ppGO_full|/max|F|. CERTIFICATION BAR = 1e-4 (Professor: 1e-3 is a probe/onset bar only; per-node ppGO error accumulates coherently across the band as ~eps*SNR^2 and 1e-3 blows the 0.05-nat lnL target; keep 1e-3 as a diagnostic column only). w_cert PER CELL is the SUP-OVER-W floor, NOT the first downward crossing: sweep w from the wall downward and record the smallest w such that the error stays < bar for ALL sampled w' in [w, w_wall] (equivalently, the last upward re-crossing) - the ppGO error is non-monotone because neglected higher-order stationary-phase terms carry image-delay phases exp(1j*w*tau_a) that beat at Delta-tau_ab and can push the residual back above the bar. Store the raw measured onset w_cert; the SAFETY MARGIN is applied at query/dispatch time as w_trust = max(1.5*w_cert, w_cert + 2.0) (raw w units) - expose this as a documented method/constant so WP2 consumes one authoritative rule. GRID: annulus rho=|y|/caustic_reach with edges {0, 0.5, 0.9, 1.0-, 1.0+, 1.5, 2.5, 4.0, inf} (the 1.0-/1.0+ split straddles the caustic: interior 4-image and exterior 2-image are DIFFERENT reconstruction objects and must never share a cell); gamma log-spaced 0.05-1.55 with extra density near gamma=0.5 (shear-series cancellation edge) and gamma=1.0 (parity boundary, never span it); w log-spaced >=12 nodes/decade over [1, wall] (astroid wall 443.7, saddle wall 58). MAX-JUMP GUARD: if adjacent-cell w_cert differ by more than the additive margin (2.0), the map must mark that pair non-interpolable (dispatch falls that region to charts) - store enough per-cell metadata for the query to enforce this. BEYOND-WALL: cells needing w > wall (m > ~458 Msun, SchwingerCertificationError) have NO exact reference - mark them UNKNOWN, never certified; the loader/query must return the UNKNOWN sentinel there, never extrapolate. Loader safety (mirror PearceyTable): a corrupt SHA1 hash raises loudly; an absent artifact path makes the process-global map None; when the map is None or a cell is UNKNOWN, w_cert query returns the UNKNOWN sentinel so WP2 refuses/charts rather than serving ppGO. In-build the sweep runs at COARSE SYNTHETIC scale (small grid, in-domain configs below the wall); the production sweep is a post-build driver step. Registry edits are mechanical: add a certified_ppgo_map stanza to DATA_CONTRACTS.yaml and data_registry.yaml and a CertifiedPpgoMap.load entry to the LOADERS dict in scripts/regenerate_consumer_graph.py, using the pearcey_table entries as the template. If a data artifact registry query is needed, the Coder may run `python scripts/pipeline_graph.py trace pearcey_table` and `resolve pearcey_table` to see the exact resolution shape to mirror.
work_packages.verification: cogwheel/lensing/ppgo_map.py exposes CertifiedPpgoMap with load (SHA1-verified), a w_cert(parity, gamma, rho) query returning a float or the UNKNOWN sentinel, and the w_trust=max(1.5*w_cert, w_cert+2.0) margin rule as a documented method/constant. A corrupt hash raises loudly and an absent path yields a None global that makes every query UNKNOWN. Beyond-wall cells return UNKNOWN. scripts/train_ppgo_map.py builds a coarse synthetic map end-to-end and writes an npz whose provenance records the 1e-4 bar, the sup-over-w floor rule, the grid axes, and the SHA1 hash; the stored w_cert per cell is the sup-over-w floor, not the first crossing. DATA_CONTRACTS.yaml, data_registry.yaml, and the regenerate_consumer_graph.py LOADERS dict each carry a certified_ppgo_map entry mirroring pearcey_table. No numerical-quadrature fallback is introduced anywhere.

work_packages.title: Per-node band-split dispatch in the lensed likelihood
work_packages.what: Make the surrogate dispatch per-node band-split instead of whole-band. A draw's dense w-band splits at w_trust (from the WP1 map): nodes below are chart-served (existing serve path), nodes above are served by bare ppGO (the existing image-kernel sum), tubes near-caustic and arms at their windows unchanged. Whole-band containment remains the rule FOR THE CHART SEGMENT only (the chart must contain the sub-band it serves). Refusal vocabulary is unchanged and beyond-wall nodes stay loud refusals.
where: cogwheel/lensing/likelihood.py: _surrogate_coefficients (approx L1330-1447) and its interaction with _amplification_coefficients (approx L1451-1551). Consumes CertifiedPpgoMap from WP1 and geometric_amplification/image_kernel from cogwheel/lensing/chang_refsdal/operator.py. surrogate.py MUST NOT be modified.
work_packages.how: Implement the split ENTIRELY inside likelihood.py _surrogate_coefficients (Simplifier ruling: do NOT change surrogate.py serve() - keep it frozen). Flow: (1) query the WP1 map for w_trust at this draw's (parity, gamma, caustic-frame rho); if the map is None or the cell is UNKNOWN, do NOT band-split - preserve today's whole-band behaviour (fall through to the existing path, which refuses beyond-wall). (2) Split the dense w array at w_trust into a chart sub-band [w_lo, w_trust] and a ppGO sub-band [w_trust, w_hi]. (3) Call surrogate.serve(dense_w_slice, ...) on the CHART sub-band slice only, so select_chart's whole-band containment is checked against the sub-band, not the full band; if the chart segment is not served, fall through to the existing exact path (no band-split served). (4) Compute the bare ppGO reconstruction for the upper sub-band nodes via the existing image-kernel sum (geometric_amplification), NOT a new formula - this is routing only. (5) Concatenate the chart-below and ppGO-above node values in w order and feed the existing kernel-reduction (_reduce_dense_kernels) to produce (delays, k0, k1, partition). Preserve the envelope_definition tag dispatch (8g-b): the chart segment reconstructs with switch=1 on real channels / critical_delay=0 for the far-field tag, unchanged. may_serve is a PERFORMANCE gate only (never affects correctness): if its whole-band log_w containment now over-rejects band-splittable candidates, weaken it to a gamma-only pre-check (Simplifier: safe, since select_chart still returns None if no chart covers the sub-band). INVARIANTS THAT MUST HOLD: F005 additive-only (never serve where a rung would refuse); per-w refusal propagation for the remaining refusal nodes (a node no rung certifies still raises the named refusal - LensDomainError/CancellationError/SchwingerCertificationError - and is NEVER routed to numerical quadrature); tube byte-identity; beyond-wall (UNKNOWN cell) stays a loud refusal. When the surrogate is None the whole path is byte-identical to today (the map query short-circuits).
work_packages.verification: _surrogate_coefficients splits a draw's dense w-band at w_trust read from the WP1 map (never a hardcoded constant): chart nodes below, bare ppGO (existing image-kernel sum) above, concatenated in w order and reduced through the existing path. surrogate.py is unmodified. When the map is None or the cell is UNKNOWN the path is byte-identical to HEAD's whole-band behaviour. Beyond-wall nodes raise the existing named refusals and are never routed to numerical quadrature. F005 additive-only, envelope_definition tag dispatch, tube byte-identity, and per-w refusal propagation all still hold.

work_packages.title: Interior (4-image) far-field tile family + strata trimming
work_packages.what: Extend the trainer to build interior (4-image) far-field tiles inside the caustic disk (minus the tube shell), using the same E_ff/real_mask label machinery (the subtraction already runs over real_mask, so an interior tile is F minus FOUR kernels automatically). Add an interior admission predicate (companion to the exterior _farfield_tiles) that admits tiles wholly inside the caustic disk minus the tube shell. Also trim mass strata whose entire w-range lies above the region's w_cert (those strata are served by ppGO and need no chart), recording each dropped stratum.
where: cogwheel/lensing/surrogate_training.py: _farfield_tiles (approx L940-979), _mass_strata (approx L884-937), _stratum_w_range (approx L844-881), _train_band_charts far-field section (approx L1438-1616), _build_farfield_chart (approx L1033-1048). Consumes CertifiedPpgoMap from WP1 for the w_cert strata cap.
work_packages.how: Add a companion admission predicate to _farfield_tiles for the INTERIOR: admit a tile only if its corner FARTHEST from the origin still lies wholly inside the caustic disk minus the tube shell (mirror the exterior 'wholly outside caustic_reach+eta_max disk' logic, inverted, so no admitted tile contains a caustic crossing or the tube shell). Enforce the one-image-count-per-box constraint by admission geometry (the tile lies entirely in the 4-image interior region), exactly as the exterior pattern enforces 2-image by geometry - NO per-point engine image-count probing. CRITICAL (Professor): build real_mask from the SIGN of morse_index per image, NEVER from a hardcoded count of 4. The 4-image count is a consequence of parity+region and flips across the caustic; a count-based mask silently mislabels near a fold/cusp where an image pair merges. The astroid interior (positive parity, gamma<1) and the saddle deltoid interior (gamma>1) are DIFFERENT caustics with different signed parity sums (astroid sum 0 vs saddle sum -2) - the admission must key off the actual caustic the cell lives in, not a bare '4 images' count. Reuse the existing E_ff far-field label and _build_farfield_chart unchanged (E_ff = F - sum_{real} H_a exp(1j*w*tau_a) telescopes back to F for any real_mask, confirmed to machine precision for 4 kernels). Interior tiles carry the far-field envelope_definition tag so WP2/serving route them via the existing switch=1 reconstruction with no serving change. STRATA TRIMMING: in _mass_strata / _stratum_w_range, when the WP1 map certifies a region, cap the stratum w-range at that region's w_cert and DROP any stratum whose entire w-range exceeds w_cert (ppGO serves it); record each dropped stratum in the report (the ladder census must attribute the cleared budget). Keep it minimal - one w_cert comparison per stratum, one report dict entry per drop; do NOT build a generalized pruning abstraction. Interior admission must loudly assert admitted > 0 wherever geometry permits (mirror the n_per_side=5 exterior admission finding) and record loudly where it does not. If the map is absent, interior tiling proceeds with the existing ceiling caps (no trim). The Coder may run `python scripts/pipeline_graph.py consumers_of lens_amplification_surrogate` to confirm no consumer contract changes for the added chart family.
work_packages.verification: surrogate_training.py admits interior (4-image) far-field tiles wholly inside the caustic disk minus the tube shell, with real_mask selected by morse_index sign (never a hardcoded 4), producing tiles carrying the existing E_ff/far-field envelope_definition tag. A tile straddling the tube shell or the caustic is rejected by admission. Interior admission loudly asserts admitted > 0 where geometry permits. _mass_strata/_stratum_w_range cap the chart w-range at the region's w_cert from the map and drop strata wholly above it, recording each dropped stratum in the training report. Exterior tiling and _build_farfield_chart behaviour are otherwise unchanged; serving needs no change because interior tiles reuse the far-field tag.

work_packages.title: Targeted edge-annulus tile subdivision
work_packages.what: Instead of densifying the far-field grid globally, subdivide only the tiles that fail the eps gate (the 166 gated v3 edge-annulus tiles): halve a failing tile into children, re-admit each child through the admission geometry, retrain, and let the eps gate decide survival. Children that still fail subdivided are recorded (their windows fall to tubes/arms/band-split ppGO and the ladder census attributes them).
where: cogwheel/lensing/surrogate_training.py: the far-field training + gating loop in _train_band_charts (approx L1438-1616), reusing _gate_chart (approx L1165-1193), _farfield_tiles admission, _build_farfield_chart, and _heldout_eps. Builds on WP3's interior/exterior admission machinery.
work_packages.how: Add a subdivision step in the far-field training loop: when a tile is gated (eps > farfield_eps_max or nan_eps), halve its half-width (h -> h/2) into up to 4 child tiles. Each child MUST be re-checked through the SAME admission predicate (exterior 'wholly outside' or WP3 interior 'wholly inside') - some children of an edge tile will now be excluded by the disk, and that is correct, not a skip (Professor/Simplifier: children re-admission is a correctness requirement). Retrain each admitted child via _build_farfield_chart and re-gate via _gate_chart. A child that passes is packed; a child that still fails is recorded in the report with its gate reason (NOT packed - it falls through to the serving ladder). Preserve WP3's strata-trim conditional and WP1/8g-b gate logic - do NOT regress them. Keep subdivision bounded (single halving level in-build synthetic scale; the production depth is a driver concern). This is purely trainer machinery; no serving or dispatch change. Record per-tile subdivision outcomes so the ladder census can attribute cleared vs still-gated windows.
work_packages.verification: The far-field training loop subdivides a gated tile by halving it, re-admits each child through the admission geometry (children excluded by the disk are correctly dropped), retrains and re-gates; passing children are packed and still-failing children are recorded with their gate reason rather than packed. WP3's strata-trim and interior admission and the WP1/8g-b gate logic are preserved. No serving/dispatch change; tube byte-identity intact.

domain_test_descriptions: BAND-SPLIT RECONSTRUCTION NODE-MATCH (WP2). Setup: construct a synthetic in-domain draw (well below the Schwinger wall) whose dense w-band straddles w_trust, with a valid coarse synthetic ppGO map installed. Operation: run the band-split dispatch and reconstruct F at every node. Expected: for nodes ABOVE w_trust (ppGO segment) assert |F_recon - F_exact|/max|F| <= 1e-4 at EVERY node (not just the first - a beat re-crossing above the floor must fail here too); for nodes BELOW w_trust (chart segment) assert |F_recon - F_exact| <= 5e-3 absolute on max|E_ff| (spline-fit currency, mirroring test_lensing_farfield_envelope.py, NOT 1e-4). Boundary/seam node: assert the chart-below and ppGO-above reconstructions agree at the split node to 5e-3 (the load-bearing assertion - catches a discontinuity at the split). Diagnostic: plot |F_recon - F_exact|/max|F| vs w with the split marked; a spike at the seam or above-floor re-crossings are the violations.

TELESCOPING IDENTITY, INTERIOR 4-IMAGE (WP3). Setup: a synthetic interior 4-image tile config (positive-parity astroid interior) with real_mask carrying four real images. Operation: reconstruct E_ff with switch=1 on all four real channels and compare to exact F. Expected: |F_recon - F_exact| <= 1e-12 * max|F| (relative to max|F|, matching the exterior ReconstructionExactnessTestCase; do NOT assert bare 1e-12 - normalize by max|F| so it does not flake at interference nulls). Diagnostic: plot the coherent 4-kernel sum residual vs w; a nonzero floor reveals a dropped Morse phase or mis-subtracted kernel.

MAP SUP-OVER-W FLOOR, NON-MONOTONE (WP1). Setup: a SYNTHETIC injected per-node error array vs w that rises past the bar at w1, dips back ABOVE the bar at w2 > w1 (a beat re-crossing), then descends below at w3. Operation: run the map's w_cert extraction on this array. Expected: the stored w_cert equals w3 (smallest w above which error < bar for ALL w' up to the wall = the LAST upward crossing), NOT w1 (first crossing). This deterministically falsifies a naive first-crossing implementation. Diagnostic: plot the error curve with w1/w2/w3 and the stored floor; a floor at w1 is the bug. (Use a synthetic array, not a real cell - a real beat location drifts and flakes.)

MAP SAFETY MARGIN (WP1). Setup: a synthetic cell with a known measured onset w_cert. Operation: query the map's dispatch-time trust frequency. Expected: w_trust == max(1.5*w_cert, w_cert + 2.0); verify the additive floor dominates at small w_cert (e.g. w_cert=1.3 -> w_trust=3.3) and the multiplicative term dominates at large w_cert (e.g. w_cert=15 -> w_trust=22.5). Diagnostic: table of w_cert vs w_trust across the measured 1.3-20 range.

CORRUPT/ABSENT/UNKNOWN MAP REFUSAL, F010 BOTH DIRECTIONS (WP1+WP2). Setup: ONE fixed synthetic draw whose band straddles w_cert. Operation & Expected: (a) with a VALID map the draw IS ppGO-served above w_trust; (b) with a CORRUPTED hash AND with an ABSENT file the SAME draw is NOT ppGO-served (loader refuses/None -> UNKNOWN -> dispatch refuses or serves chart-only); (c) a BEYOND-WALL (UNKNOWN) cell is never served even with a valid map; (d) assert the refusal in (b)/(c) is loud/named and does NOT fall through to numerical quadrature (the zero-quadrature mandate). The served-vs-refused flip on the identical input is the load-bearing evidence. Diagnostic: a truth table of (map state) x (served? / refusal type) for the fixed draw.

INTERIOR ADMISSION GEOMETRY + MORSE-SIGN MASK (WP3). Setup: synthetic tiles relative to a known caustic disk and tube shell. Operation & Expected: (a) a tile wholly inside the caustic disk minus the tube shell is ADMITTED with a 4-image real_mask; (b) a tile straddling the tube shell OR the caustic is REJECTED; (c) 'admitted > 0 where geometry permits' fires as a loud assert. CRITICAL morse-sign fixture: include an interior config ADJACENT to a cusp where one image sits near a fold (near-degenerate eigenvalue) so the real_mask must be selected by morse_index SIGN - a hardcoded len==4 mask either mislabels the near-degenerate image or fails to drop it, and this config is what catches the hardcoded-4 bug (a generic deep-interior tile will not). Diagnostic: overlay admitted/rejected tiles on the caustic+tube-shell geometry; list per-image morse signs for the cusp-adjacent tile.

STRATA TRIMMING RECORD (WP3). Setup: a synthetic band with a map certifying w_cert below the top of at least one mass stratum's w-range. Operation: run _mass_strata/_stratum_w_range with the map installed. Expected: strata whose entire w-range exceeds w_cert are DROPPED and each drop is recorded in the training report with its stratum index and w-range; the retained strata are capped at w_cert. With no map installed, no trim occurs (existing ceiling caps only). Diagnostic: report diff of strata list with vs without the map.

EDGE-ANNULUS SUBDIVISION (WP4). Setup: a deliberately failing synthetic edge tile (eps above the far-field bar). Operation: run the subdivision step. Expected: the tile halves into children; each child is re-checked through admission (a child now excluded by the disk is correctly dropped, not skipped); admitted children retrain and re-gate; a passing child is packed and a still-failing child is recorded with its gate reason (not packed). Diagnostic: tree view of parent tile -> children with per-child admission result and eps vs bar.
simplifier_inputs: Keep 4 WPs; WP3 and WP4 share surrogate_training.py but touch different functions (interior admission predicate vs subdivision loop) and WP4 is genuinely sequential on WP3 - keeping them separate gives WP4 its own turn budget.

Band-split must live ENTIRELY in likelihood.py _surrogate_coefficients; do NOT change surrogate.py serve() - call serve on the chart sub-band slice, compute the bare ppGO sum for the upper slice in the dispatch, concatenate, reduce. This keeps surrogate.py frozen (consistent with the tube-frozen fence).

may_serve is a performance gate only (never correctness); if its whole-band containment over-rejects band-splittable candidates, weaken it to a gamma-only check - select_chart still returns None if no chart covers the sub-band, so it is safe.

The hash-pinned data product is NOT overkill: the 'refuse-to-certify when absent/corrupt' mandate is the safety invariant that makes band-split safe (a stale map could silently certify the wrong w_cert and route wave-zone nodes to ppGO). The PearceyTable precedent makes the cost near-zero.

DATA_CONTRACTS/data_registry/consumer-graph edits belong inside WP1 as mechanical bookkeeping subtasks (mirror pearcey_table), not as co-equal design concerns; the one load-bearing piece is the LOADERS dict entry for CertifiedPpgoMap.load.

Strata trimming rightly folds into WP3 (it needs WP1's map and reuses _mass_strata which WP3 already modifies); keep it minimal - one w_cert comparison per stratum, one report entry per drop, no generalized pruning abstraction.
Interior-tile subdivision children MUST re-check disk admission - some children of an edge tile become excluded; this is a correctness requirement, not an optional refinement.
professor_inputs: Q1 SAFETY MARGIN: w_trust = max(1.5*w_cert, w_cert + 2.0) per cell, applied after the sup-over-w certification. Multiplicative 1.5x buys ~2.3x headroom against the C2/w^2 tail at high w; the +2.0 additive floor protects low-w cells (w_cert~1.3) where the multiplicative margin is thinner than a grid spacing.

Q2 MONOTONICITY: the ppGO error is NOT monotone - neglected higher-order stationary-phase terms carry image-delay phases exp(1j*w*tau_a) that beat and can push the residual back above the bar at higher w (worst near-caustic where Delta-tau is small). The map MUST store the sup-over-w floor (smallest w with error<bar for ALL w' up to the wall = last upward re-crossing), NEVER the first crossing. A single first-crossing threshold is unsafe.

Q3 CERTIFICATION BAR: certify at per-node eps < 1e-4 F-normalized, NOT 1e-3. 1e-3 is the probe/onset bar only; per-node ppGO errors accumulate coherently in the lnL integrand (~eps*SNR^2, ratio O(1)), so 1e-3 x ~300 SNR^2 ~ 0.3 nats = 6x over the 0.05 target with zero headroom; 1e-4 gives ~0.03 nats. Re-run the census on v4 to confirm ppGO nodes did not become the dominant error term.

Q4 GRID: annulus edges {0,0.5,0.9,1.0-,1.0+,1.5,2.5,4.0,inf} (the 1.0-/1.0+ split straddles the caustic - interior 4-image and exterior 2-image are different objects, never share a cell); gamma log 0.05-1.55, 6-8 cells with extra density at gamma=0.5 (shear-series cancellation edge) and gamma=1.0 (parity boundary, never span it); w log >=12 nodes/decade over [1,wall]; max-jump guard: refuse to interpolate across adjacent cells whose w_cert differ by more than the additive margin (2.0).

Q5 INTERIOR TILES: E_ff = F - (4 real kernels) with switch=1 on all four channels telescopes back to F to machine precision (label-count agnostic). Build real_mask from morse_index SIGN per image, NEVER a hardcoded count of 4 - the count flips across the caustic and a count-based mask silently mislabels at fold/cusp merges. The astroid interior (parity sum 0) and saddle deltoid interior (parity sum -2) are DIFFERENT caustics; admission must key off the actual caustic the cell lives in.

Q6 BEYOND-WALL: dispatch MUST refuse (loud, unchanged vocabulary) beyond the Schwinger wall - the exact reference does not exist there, so UNKNOWN can never certify (the F005 invariant in its purest form). The acceptance number 'quadrature = 0% outside the beyond-wall heavy-saddle tail' with the tail equal to its measured ~360/1024 (m>458) size is correct; report the beyond-wall bucket as a measured invariant, not a tolerance. This is 8h-b territory.

TEST BARS (in-build fast tier): ppGO segment <=1e-4 F-normalized at every node; chart segment 5e-3 absolute on max|E_ff| (spline currency, reuse test_lensing_farfield_envelope.py vocabulary); seam agreement 5e-3 (load-bearing); telescoping 1e-12*max|F| (normalized, not bare); sup-floor test uses a SYNTHETIC injected beat array (a real cell drifts/flakes); F010 both directions on ONE fixed draw plus a beyond-wall UNKNOWN case, and assert the refusal is loud and does NOT fall through to quadrature; interior admission fixture MUST include a cusp-adjacent mixed-morse-sign config to catch a hardcoded-4 mask.

CROSS-CUTTING: the rho~1-plus/minus annulus edge cells inherit the near-caustic high-lnL-error risk (an 8a near-caustic box-edge config gave a 12.8-nat error at eps=0.16). The 1e-4 bar, the sup-over-w floor, and the Q1 margin are three INDEPENDENT guards; the driver should re-gate the 1e-4 bar against one real high-SNR near-caustic draw before the v4 campaign (post-build).
